bug.title: Checkout order submission remains on checkout with error message
bug.reason: Checkpoint assertion failed: "an order confirmation page says "Thank you, Łucja Nowak!""

verdict.title: Checkout order submission remains on checkout with error message
verdict.oneLiner: The order was not confirmed: checkout remained open and displayed an error instead of the requested thank-you message and order number.
verdict.rootCause: After the customer details were entered, the checkout did not complete the order. It stayed on the checkout page and showed an error message, so no confirmation page or order number was available.
verdict.suggestion: Investigate the order-submission path and its server response. When the entered checkout details are accepted, send the shopper to a confirmation page with the thank-you message and order number; if submission truly fails, provide a specific, actionable error.

flow.title: A shopper with a non-Latin name can place an order
steps: Wait for the "Added to cart" message
Fill in Full name with "Łucja Nowak", Email with lucja@example.test, Address with "12 Clay Street" and City with "Portland"
expect: An order confirmation page says "Thank you, Łucja Nowak!"
The confirmation shows an order number
flow.notes: Breaker's suspicion: server.js:322 puts the raw customer name into the X-Order-Ref response header. Node's setHeader throws ERR_INVALID_CHAR for any character above U+00FF (Ł, CJK, Arabic, emoji). The order has already been pushed at server.js:320, so the shopper sees 'Something went wrong' even though a phantom order exists, and a retry creates a duplicate.
